scientific_choices.rationale: Reuse four selected text-recall checkpoints, canonical256 predictions, the trained offset epoch82, original exclusive GT boxes and pinned PARSeq helpers; all125 holdout images/983 care words.
Keep training-selected thresholds and compare common0.50 separately; no OCR checkpoint reselection or threshold search. Duplicate crops across512 checkpoints/policies reuse identical RGB hashes.

Per-component Gaussian-smoothed distance maxima with relative height0.6/radius1/spacing8 seed the existing minimax watershed. Retain every foreground pixel and one marker for tiny components. Shapes may over-split; these settings are predeclared diagnostics.

Reuse existing global endpoint consensus with sigma3/density0.5/spacing8/support8/radius12 and disable growth. Offset outputs remain512/256 and are aligned with every canonical256 text map; no offset retraining for768. Existing poor baseline results are retained, not repeated.

Identical pad0/no area/no cap isolates shape/instance effects; not strict paper localization. Geometry and exact-casefold text require one-to-one IoU>=0.50. Only fully invalid predicted instances are ignored after inference; punctuation retained, all983 GT words remain counted.

Fuse frozen RTX3090 FP32 maps on CPU and run only PARSeq CPU FP32/batch8. Reuse OCR only with exact RGB hashes, pinned artifacts, checked source-record hashes and16-crop replay; no simultaneous model or RTX3070 claim.
Repeated TRAIN holdout is exploratory; official TEST, rotated/rectified crop effects, different padding and improved learned kernels remain separate experiments.
